metadata.question: Was the area of forest cover between the Ucayali and Genepanshea Rivers larger along UC-105, at 5 km radius around center (-9.799994, -73.845369), on August 21, 2022 than on August 23, 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Hansen Global Forest Change or JRC Global Surface Water for forest, but better to use Sentinel-2 or Landsat for specific dates - For forest cover, I'll use Sentinel-2 (more recent, 10m resolution) with NDVI as a proxy for vegetation/forest - Dates: August 21, 2022 vs August 23, 2017 - Location: Center point (-9.799994, -73.845369) with 5km radius - For 2017, Sentinel-2 should be available (launched 2015/2017) 2. Masking strategy: - Yes, mask clouds since we want to measure actual forest cover - Use QA60 band for Sentinel-2 cloud masking 3. Logic: - Calculate vegetated/forest area (NDVI > threshold, e.g., 0.6) for both dates - Compare: if 2022 area > 2017 area → A (Yes), else → B (No) - Handle C1 (no images), C2 (no valid pixels after masking), C3 (invalid calculation) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const centerPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-73.845369, -9.799994]); const roi = centerPoint.buffer(5000); // 5km radius const date2017 = '2017-08-23'; const date2022 = '2022-08-21'; const dateWindow = 15; // days window for cloud-free images // 2. Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 3. Data Acquisition for 2017 let col2017 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(ee.Date(date2017).advance(-dateWindow, 'day'), ee.Date(date2017).advance(dateWindow, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) .map(maskS2clouds); const size2017 = col2017.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2017 Images found: ${size2017}`); if (size2017 === 0) { // Try Landsat 8 as fallback col2017 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(ee.Date(date2017).advance(-dateWindow, 'day'), ee.Date(date2017).advance(dateWindow, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const size2017_ls = col2017.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2017 Landsat fallback: ${size2017_ls}`); if (size2017_ls === 0) { console.log("No data for 2017"); console.log("C1"); return; } } // 4. Data Acquisition for 2022 let col2022 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(ee.Date(date2022).advance(-dateWindow, 'day'), ee.Date(date2022).advance(dateWindow, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) .map(maskS2clouds); const size2022 = col2022.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2022 Images found: ${size2022}`); if (size2022 === 0) { console.log("No data for 2022"); console.log("C1"); return; } // 5. Calculate NDVI and forest area function calculateForestArea(collection) { const composite = collection.median(); const ndvi = composite.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); const forest = ndvi.gt(0.6); // Forest threshold // Count forest pixels const stats = forest.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: roi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); return stats; } const stats2017 = calculateForestArea(col2017); const forestArea2017 = stats2017.get('NDVI_sum').getInfo(); const pixelCount2017 = stats2017.get('NDVI_count').getInfo(); console.log(`2017: Forest pixels=${forestArea2017}, Total pixels=${pixelCount2017}`); if (pixelCount2017 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels for 2017 after masking"); console.log("C2"); return; } const stats2022 = calculateForestArea(col2022); const forestArea2022 = stats2022.get('NDVI_sum').getInfo(); const pixelCount2022 = stats2022.get('NDVI_count').getInfo(); console.log(`2022: Forest pixels=${forestArea2022}, Total pixels=${pixelCount2022}`); if (pixelCount2022 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels for 2022 after masking"); console.log("C2"); return; } // 6. Validation & Final Answer if (forestArea2017 === null || forestArea2022 === null || isNaN(forestArea2017) || isNaN(forestArea2022)) { console.log("Calculation failed"); console.log("C3"); return; } console.log(`Forest area comparison: 2022=${forestArea2022.toFixed(0)} vs 2017=${forestArea2017.toFixed(0)}`); if (forestArea2022 > forestArea2017) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
